title: Cloud Infrastructure SLA and Reliability Report

facts.statement: CoreSync maintains a service level agreement target of 99.95% monthly uptime.
facts.normalized_statement: CoreSync SLA target is 99.95% monthly uptime.

source_reference.verbatim_text_span: maintains a service level agreement (SLA) target of 99.95% monthly uptime.

facts.statement: CoreSync achieved an actual uptime of 99.98% during Q3 2025 across all three active availability zones in us-east.
facts.normalized_statement: In Q3 2025, CoreSync achieved 99.98% uptime across 3 availability zones in us-east.

source_reference.verbatim_text_span: achieved an actual uptime of 99.98% across all three active availability zones in the us-east region.

facts.distractor_notes: Do not confuse 99.98% actual with 99.95% target.

facts.statement: The primary cluster operates on 128 dedicated compute nodes with 64 GB memory and dual 10 Gbps network interfaces.
facts.normalized_statement: The primary cluster has 128 compute nodes with 64 GB RAM and dual 10 Gbps NICs.

source_reference.verbatim_text_span: operates on 128 dedicated compute nodes, each provisioned with 64 GB of memory and dual 10 Gbps network interfaces.

facts.statement: The 95th percentile read latency remained at 18 milliseconds throughout Q3 2025.
facts.normalized_statement: P95 read latency was 18 ms in Q3 2025.

source_reference.verbatim_text_span: average 95th percentile read latency remained at 18 milliseconds throughout Q3 2025

facts.statement: Write latency peaked at 42 milliseconds during batch synchronization windows.
facts.normalized_statement: Peak write latency reached 42 ms during batch synchronization.

source_reference.verbatim_text_span: write latency peaked at 42 milliseconds during batch synchronization windows.

facts.statement: The incident detection pipeline triggered 4 warning alerts with an MTTR of 6.5 minutes.
facts.normalized_statement: In Q3 2025, 4 warning alerts were triggered with a 6.5-minute MTTR.

source_reference.verbatim_text_span: pipeline triggered 4 warning alerts during the quarter, with a mean time to recovery (MTTR) of 6.5 minutes.

facts.statement: Maximum sustained throughput reached 85,000 operations per second on September 14, 2025.
